name: Venomweb Vale
summary: South of the Scarlet Monastery, Venomweb Vale lies under a swarm of venomous spiders. Once, hunters tracked deer and rabbits through its woodland.

sections.title: A Blighted Refuge
sections.body:
Venomweb Vale has lost its peaceful hunting ground to rot and gloom. Before the plague consumed Lordaeron, hunters followed deer and rabbits through its grass and trees. Now giant venomous spiders swarm through the trees and hollows, led by the monstrous Sri'skulk.

To the north, the Scarlet Crusade holds the neighboring territory. Darkhounds prowl near the fortified Scarlet Encampment, where Lieutenant Sanders commands.

faq.q: Why are there so many spiders in Venomweb Vale?
faq.answer: Venomweb Vale was once a hunting ground for deer and rabbits. Now poisonous spiders led by Sri'skulk overrun it, and their deadly webs and venom gave the vale its name.

faq.q: Who rules the arachnids in the vale?
faq.answer: Sri'skulk leads the spider brood in Venomweb Vale, stalking the hollows beneath its blighted canopy.

angles.text: As a Forsaken traveler heading toward the Scarlet Monastery, you must navigate Sri'skulk's lethal brood and the watchful Crusader patrols led by Lieutenant Sanders to the north.
